code:
# 镜像安全基线：六条可静态判定的规则，正反两组 Dockerfile 对照，输出合规率。

BAD_DF = r"""FROM node:22
COPY . /app
WORKDIR /app
RUN npm install
ENV API_TOKEN=abcdef123456
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "index.js"]
"""

GOOD_DF = r"""FROM node:22.11.0-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev && npm cache clean --force
COPY src/ ./src/
USER node
EXPOSE 3000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s CMD node -e "require('http').get('http://127.0.0.1:3000/healthz',r=>process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1)).on('error',()=>process.exit(1))"
CMD ["node", "src/index.js"]
"""


def parse(text):
    logical, buf = [], ""
    for raw in text.splitlines():
        line = raw.rstrip()
        if buf:
            buf = buf.rstrip("\\") + " " + line.strip()
            if not line.endswith("\\"):
                logical.append(buf)
                buf = ""
            continue
        if line.endswith("\\"):
            buf = line
        else:
            logical.append(line)
    out = []
    for s in (x.strip() for x in logical):
        if not s or s.startswith("#"):
            continue
        p = s.split(None, 1)
        out.append((p[0].upper(), p[1] if len(p) > 1 else ""))
    return out


CHECKS = [
    "非 root 运行（显式 USER 且不是 0/root）",
    "基础镜像固定版本或 digest（不用 latest）",
    "声明 HEALTHCHECK（编排系统才能判断存活）",
    "存在 .dockerignore（不把 .git/密钥/依赖送进上下文）",
    "安装依赖后清理包管理器缓存",
    "镜像内无明文密钥（不在 ENV/ARG 里写 token、不 COPY .env）",
]


def audit(instrs, has_dockerignore):
    froms = [a for ins, a in instrs if ins == "FROM"]
    users = [a for ins, a in instrs if ins == "USER"]
    runs = [a for ins, a in instrs if ins == "RUN"]
    envs = [a for ins, a in instrs if ins in ("ENV", "ARG")]
    copies = [a for ins, a in instrs if ins in ("COPY", "ADD")]

    c1 = bool(users) and users[-1].split(":")[0] not in ("0", "root")
    c2 = all(("@sha256:" in f) or (":" in f and f.split(":")[-1] != "latest") for f in froms)
    c3 = any(ins == "HEALTHCHECK" for ins, _ in instrs)
    c4 = has_dockerignore
    c5 = not any(("apt-get install" in r and "rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists" not in r)
                 or ("pip install" in r and "--no-cache-dir" not in r)
                 or ("npm install" in r and "npm cache clean" not in r) for r in runs)
    secret_words = ("TOKEN", "PASSWORD", "SECRET", "ACCESS_KEY", "PRIVATE_KEY")
    c6 = (not any(any(w in e.upper() for w in secret_words) for e in envs)
          and not any(a.split()[0].endswith(".env") for a in copies))
    return [c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6]


def report(name, instrs, has_dockerignore):
    print("=== %s ===" % name)
    print("  .dockerignore 存在: %s" % has_dockerignore)
    res = audit(instrs, has_dockerignore)
    for i, (desc, ok) in enumerate(zip(CHECKS, res), 1):
        print("  %d. %-46s %s" % (i, desc, "PASS" if ok else "FAIL"))
    passed = sum(1 for x in res if x)
    rate = passed / len(res) * 100
    print("  合规率 = %d/%d = %.1f%%" % (passed, len(res), rate))
    print("  达标（>= 80%%）: %s" % (rate >= 80.0))
    print()
    return rate


bad_rate = report("[反例] node:22 + COPY . + npm install + ENV TOKEN",
                  parse(BAD_DF), has_dockerignore=False)
good_rate = report("[正例] 固定版本 + npm ci + USER node + HEALTHCHECK",
                   parse(GOOD_DF), has_dockerignore=True)

print("=== 汇总 ===")
print("反例合规率 = %.1f%% ; 正例合规率 = %.1f%%" % (bad_rate, good_rate))
print("反例不达标 / 正例达标: %s / %s" % (bad_rate < 80.0, good_rate >= 80.0))
print()
print("补充（无法从 Dockerfile 静态判定、但同样属于基线的项）:")
print("  --security-opt no-new-privileges:true")
print("  只读根文件系统 docker run --read-only，写目录单独挂 tmpfs")
print("  丢弃全部 capability（--cap-drop=ALL），只加回需要的那个")
print("  镜像漏洞扫描（trivy / grype）接入 CI")
